merges.reason: Both cover CVE-2026-82329 (Artifactory auth bypass, CVSS 9.8). The into story has 3 sources and 3 events; the from story is a single-source malware.news piece about the same CVE with no additional information.

Both cover CVE-2026-60004 (Gitea RCE). The into story has 4 sources covering the advisory and KEV addition. The from story is a single-source BleepingComputer piece about 8,300+ exposed servers, which is a follow-up exploitation update to the same vulnerability. Merging consolidates the coverage.
